url.ui:title: Open Live backend URL
url.ui:description: Full https address of the Open Live backend, for example magnus-mylive.eyevinn-open-live.auto.prod-se.osaas.io

apiKey.ui:title: API key (self-hosted Open Live)
apiKey.ui:description: Leave empty and set OPEN_LIVE_API_KEY on the gateway instead; values here are written to the gateway log

oscPat.ui:title: OSC Personal Access Token
oscPat.ui:description: Leave empty and set OPEN_LIVE_OSC_PAT on the gateway instead; values here are written to the gateway log
